name: proyecto_truc
title_zh: 七件套：从选品到上架的独立站小工具
tagline_zh: 一个人开店最烦的不是没货，是选品、定价、写文案、上架各占一个工具。这七件凑成一包。
tagline_en: Running a one-person shop means juggling selection, pricing, copy and listing. These seven tools ship as one.
why_zh: 七件各自独立，不共享状态也不互相调用，装哪件用哪件，坏一件不拖累其余六件。
why_en: All seven are independent: no shared state, no cross-calls, so one breaking never drags down the other six.
limit_zh: 只是打包，不含统一入口或编排；七件之间不传数据，想串成流水线得自己接。仓库无演示与截图，装前建议先读各件说明。
limit_en: It is just a bundle: no unified entry or orchestration, no data passing between the seven. No demos or screenshots in the repo, so read each skill's.

install.note: clone 下来，挑你要的那件复制进 ~/.claude/skills/。这是一个合集，没有「装它」这个动作。

title_en: Seven standalone tools for a small online shop
